03 / EXCHANGE · IN DISCOVERY

Good parts.
Shared possibilities.

We’re exploring a place for builders to share parts knowledge and reusable robot skills. Tell us what you need, what you can offer, and what would make an exchange useful.

FUTURE DISTRICT

The Exchange is a concept in discovery. Listings, checkout, seller verification, and skill downloads are not available.

PARTS & REPAIR

Find the missing piece.

A future exchange could help builders identify compatible parts, repair an existing robot, and share sourcing experience.

Suggest a parts need ↗
REUSABLE SKILLS

Share behavior with context.

A proposed skill package would declare its version, supported body, permissions, and evaluation evidence. Installing a package would remain separate from authorizing its execution.

Read the proposed contract ↗
BUILDER KNOWLEDGE

Make the next build easier.

Compatibility notes, calibration methods, known limitations, and reproducible experiments could be as valuable as the parts themselves.

Shape the exchange ↗

A SKILL NEEDS MORE THAN A FILE

Before sharing becomes execution.

01

Identify

Which version, author, robot body, and runtime does the package target?

02

Evaluate

Which simulations and hardware tests support the claimed behavior?

03

Authorize

Who may request the action, under which constraints and local controls?

04

Explain

What evidence records completion, interruption, or an unresolved result?

THE NEXT SMALL STEP

What should builders be able to exchange?

A part you can’t find, a skill you want to reuse, or a compatibility problem is a good place to begin.
